        About ANTSY

        A colony of individuals.

        ANTSY is a miniature world you can watch, poke, and get attached to. Beneath the sand, a small colony runs on its own routines: scouts look for food, foragers bring it home, builders dig new rooms, and everyone needs a rest now and then.

        No two ants are alike. Each has a name, a role, a few personality traits, and memories of things that actually happened to it. Curious ants wander farther, cautious ants keep to familiar ground, and social ants stop to chat.

        Drop some food or place an obstacle and the colony adapts: ants notice, reroute, and carry what they find back to storage.

        Simulated personalities · runs locally in your browser

        • Scouts

          Explore the surface, spot new food, and bring the news back to the nest.

        • Foragers

          Follow the trail, collect food piece by piece, and fill the storage room.

        • Builders

          Dig new tunnels, haul soil to the surface, and open up fresh chambers.
